Areas served on Montreal’s North Shore

From Laval to Saint-Jérôme and from Mirabel to Repentigny, we deliver to every city on the North Shore, including the industrial parks of Boisbriand, Blainville, Terrebonne and Mirabel. Deliveries between the North Shore and the island of Montreal or the South Shore are done the same day.

FAQ

FAQ — montreal north shore delivery

Do you deliver between the North Shore and Montreal the same day?

Yes. Crossing the bridges is part of our daily routine; with express service, a Laval–Montreal or Terrebonne–Montreal delivery is done the same day.

Do you cover Saint-Jérôme and Mirabel?

Yes, as well as the Laurentian towns further north on request, scheduled or next day.

Do you do moves on the North Shore?

Yes, on weekends, with an equipped truck, fuel and mileage included. See our moving page.

Can you unload a container at a warehouse in Boisbriand or Terrebonne?

Yes, our handling crew goes to every industrial park on the North Shore.
